text:
evie: Quick sync  overnight soft-flip to prefer v2 for mixed clients created a subtle compatibility hit: some v1 clients rely on header X-Model-Config that v2 ignores and quality regressed for a few customers. Need a short-term mitigations list + longer deprecation UX.
samir: saw it, noticed a ~3% failure/regression rate on retraces for v1 clients. should we add a console flag to "respect-legacy-headers" per-route?
kelly: +1. Ops mitigation ideas: 1) per-route legacy-compat toggle; 2) deprecation banner in console for routes using deprecated headers; 3) telemetry tag `compat_mode` to track which path served request.
build-bot: auto: alert annotated: affected_routes=8, regression_signal=0.031, top_header=X-Model-Config, suggested_action=enable_compat_toggle_candidate
frank: runtime nuance: v2 model selection ignores X-Model-Config intentionally (mismatch with new quantization profiles). Adding a compat toggle is feasible but we should document performance tradeoffs and a cost-warning.
dina: UX: banner should show "This route uses deprecated header X-Model-Config. v2 ignores it. Options: enable compat-mode (cost + perf warning) | Migrate clients | Pin to v1". Provide one-click migrate guidance and a validation dry-run.
evie: proposal: implement both quick mitigations and a roadmap: short-term - per-route compat toggle + telemetry; mid-term - console migration assistant with dry-run & impact preview; long-term - formal deprecation timeline + partner outreach.
samir: telemetry request: emit `served_version=v1|v2`, `compat_mode=on|off`, `client_header_present=true|false`, `quality_regression_signal` and keep events for 120 days for postmortem/billing deltas.
kelly: add alerts: if regression_signal > 1% for a route after flip, surface an "auto-suggest pin" banner with recommended action and one-click API call.
frank: API snippets for ops (ephemeral compat toggle):
```bash
curl -X POST https://console.internal/api/route/compat_toggle \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"route":"/v1/chat","compat_mode":true,"ttl":"6h","reason":"legacy-header-break"}'
```
dina: also UX ask: show a small per-route "compat impact" preview that runs a 5-min dry-run to estimate token delta & perf delta. Display in banner as "estimated token increase +X% / latency +Yms".
evie: runbook quick steps: detect affected routes -> enable compat_toggle ephemeral -> run 5-min dry-run to confirm -> if stable, plan migration with customer; if not, pin to v1. Add rollback snippet to revert toggle.
build-bot: auto: follow-up reminder scheduled in 45m.
samir: security/RBAC note: only roles with `toggle:compat` may enable compat_mode. Add audit log fields: actor, reason, ttl, previous_state.
kelly: deprecation UX: when we start formal deprecation, console should show timeline (warning 90d/60d/30d), migration checklist, and an automated migration assistant that validates client headers and offers code snippets for common SDKs.
frank: migration assistant should also emit a compatibility report per-tenant showing percentage of requests carrying deprecated headers and likely impact score. Useful for customer ops.
dina: can product own the short banner copy? i'll draft microcopy: "This route receives legacy X-Model-Config header. v2 ignores this header which may change results. [Enable compat-mode (temp)] [Run dry-run] [Migrate clients]". Also include a small tooltip for why perf/cost may change.
evie: telemetry/metrics owners: samir -> add compat_mode tags + retention; kelly -> UX banner + auto-suggest; frank -> make sure runtime honors toggle and emits cost warnings; dina -> microcopy + migration checklist. I'll own the runbook & customer comms.
samir: i'll add an alert that triggers when compat_mode toggled >5 times in 24h for same route (signal of churn).
build-bot: auto: action created: ENG-ops-compat-467 assigned to frank, due 3d.
dina: small edge-case: if we enable compat_mode on v2, we must also ensure function-calling & structured-output behavior remains stable; include test harness in dry-run.
frank: noted. will add E2E smoke tests in the dry-run flow.
evie: thanks all. goal: land ephemeral compat_toggle + telemetry + banner this sprint so we can immediately mitigate customer impact and buy time for migration.
kelly: will post UI mockups in #design by EOD.
build-bot: auto: follow-up reminder scheduled in 2h.
